text:
laura: Heads up — several external interviewers report they can't access the prep docs attached to candidate records. links return a 403.

ben: same here. the drive links in the scorecard attachments are dead. internal folks can open them.

rachel: any recent changes to sharing policies?

ethan: we rolled the new org-wide Drive sharing baseline last night (restrictExternalShare = true) to tighten export controls. I assumed redwood-hr links were exempt.

laura: looks like the ATS importer rewrites attachments to our proxy: `https://files.redwood.com/att/att-987` — the proxy's service account lost permission on the Drive folder after the baseline.

ben: can we revert the baseline for the hr-prep folder? that's risky. alternative: grant the proxy service account explicit viewer access to the folder.

ethan: I'll add the service account (`svc-ats-proxy@redwood.iam`) to the folder access list and test.

ops-bot: follow-up ticket created: OPS-5293. Assigned to ethan.

rachel: timeline? interviews start in 4 hours. external contractors need prep PDFs.

ethan: giving access now, will ping when links validate.

ci-bot: Docs proxy health check: 200 OK for /att/att-987 (verified).

laura: confirmed with one vendor interviewer, link works now. please add a note to the vendor email about reloading the invite so attachments update.

ben: tiny follow-up — can we add a preflight check in the importer to surface missing proxy permissions? would catch this before scheduling.

ethan: good idea. I'll add a permission check to the import pipeline and a quick unit test.

laura: thanks all. closing loop once OPS-5293 is done.
